scope_option_scope: Scope of the Semantic run: full (recommended, the default), selected or incremental. Independent of purpose, rigor and budget.
scope_option_path: Selected scope: a path, folder or glob to review (repeatable).
scope_option_subsystem: Selected scope: a layer id of .jgates/architecture.yml to review (repeatable).
scope_option_exclude: A glob never reviewed nor read as context (strict; repeatable).
scope_option_base: Incremental scope: the base Git reference to compare with (required for incremental). A reference is a comparison anchor, never evidence of a previous review.
scope_option_target: Incremental scope: the target Git reference (default HEAD).
scope_option_dirty: Incremental scope: dirty and untracked changes to include: none (default), all, or a path (repeatable). Needs the target to be HEAD.
scope_option_baseline: A prior Semantic run whose evidence may be reused after current checks: latest or a sem_ ID. Without it, nothing is inherited.
scope_option_context_policy: Supporting context policy: strict (default; only the previewed context) or bounded (automatic expansion inside the limits, recorded).
scope_option_context_max_depth: Deepest import relation followed for context (default 1; 0 follows none).
scope_option_allow_context: A path, folder or glob explicitly allowed as supporting context (repeatable).
scope_option_purpose: Shortcut for a method list: general-review (default) or security (same as --method security-audit). Ignored when --method is given.
scope_option_rigor: Depth of the examination: quick, standard (default) or deep. It never changes the scope.
scope_option_budget_calls: Most provider calls for this run. It never changes the scope.
scope_option_budget_tokens: Most tokens for this run. It never changes the scope.
scope_cli_bad_scope: Unknown scope {value}: use full, selected or incremental.
scope_cli_bad_purpose: Unknown purpose {value}: use general-review or security.
scope_cli_bad_rigor: Unknown rigor {value}: use quick, standard or deep.
scope_cli_bad_context_policy: Unknown context policy {value}: use strict or bounded.
scope_cli_bad_dirty: --dirty takes none, all, or paths; none and all cannot be combined with paths.
scope_cli_fix: See jgates semantic --help for the scope flags.
scope_text_summary: Scope: {mode} (methods {methods}, rigor {rigor}): {examine} to examine, {reused} reused, {context} context, {excluded} excluded
scope_text_recommended: {path} is recommended as context but kept out by the policy or the limits.
scope_plan_method_unavailable: The method {method} is not available in this build.
scope_plan_target_not_checked_out: The general review reads files from the working tree, which does not hold the target of this scope (another commit checked out, or dirty files that were not selected). Check out the target or select its dirty files with --dirty.
scope_api_policy_mode: A policy folder being edited is not a project: there is no scope to preview.
scope_limitation_python_regex_scan: Python imports are found with a regular-expression scan (no parser): conditional, aliased or generated imports may be missed.
scope_limitation_aliases_and_computed_im: Path aliases (tsconfig paths, bundler aliases) and imports computed at run time are not resolved; they are listed as unknowns.
scope_limitation_other_languages_without: Other languages contribute changed files only, without import relations.
scope_limitation_indirect_calls_not_trac: Calls through dependency injection, routing tables, reflection or configuration are not traced.
scope_reason_not_text: Not a text file: no reviewer reads it.
scope_reason_prior_unresolved_affected: Left unresolved by {runId} and reached by the change: examined again.
scope_reason_imports_affected: Imports {path}, which imports a changed file.
scope_reason_limit_files: Kept out: the context limit of {max} files is reached.
scope_reason_limit_bytes: Kept out: the context limit of {max} bytes is reached.
scope_blocker_scope_path_outside: {path} is not a path inside the workspace.
scope_blocker_scope_subjects_not_applica: A full scope takes no subjects: use --scope selected to review chosen paths.
scope_blocker_scope_subjects_required: A selected scope needs at least one path or subsystem.
scope_blocker_scope_comparison_not_appli: A {mode} scope takes no base, target or dirty selection: use --scope incremental.
scope_blocker_scope_base_required: An incremental scope needs an explicit base reference (--base).
scope_blocker_scope_requires_git: An incremental scope needs a Git work tree.
scope_blocker_scope_dirty_requires_head_: Dirty changes can only be laid over HEAD, and the target {ref} is another commit.
scope_blocker_scope_no_changes: The comparison has no change in scope: there is nothing to review.
scope_blocker_scope_empty: The scope has no file to review.
scope_warning_scope_source_unknown: The source identity could not be taken.
scope_warning_scope_dirty_path_clean: {path} has no dirty or untracked change.
scope_warning_scope_baseline_not_found: No Semantic run matches the baseline {ref}: nothing is inherited.
scope_warning_scope_baseline_without_led: The baseline {runId} has no scope ledger: nothing is inherited.
scope_warning_scope_baseline_other_repos: The baseline {runId} belongs to another repository: nothing is inherited.
scope_warning_scope_allow_empty: The allowed context {path} matches no file.
scope_unknown_dynamic_import: {path} imports a computed module ({detail}): it may load changed code that the proposal cannot see.
scope_unknown_computed_require: {path} requires a computed module ({detail}): it may load changed code that the proposal cannot see.
scope_unknown_unparseable: {path} could not be parsed ({detail}): its imports are unknown.
scope_unknown_unresolved_import: {path} imports {detail}, which resolves to no file of the workspace.
scope_unknown_file_too_large: {path} is too large to parse ({detail}): its imports are unknown.
scope_unknown_graph_limit: {path} was not parsed ({detail}): its imports are unknown.
scope_unknown_dependency_change_unmapped: {path} changed ({detail}), and which code uses the changed dependencies is not mapped.
scope_unknown_config_consumers_unknown: {path} changed ({detail}), and which code reads it is not known.
scope_unknown_status_truncated: The Git status was truncated ({detail}): some dirty files are not listed.
scope_inherited_no_baseline: None: no prior audit was named, so this run inherits no repository coverage.
scope_inherited_baseline_not_found: None: the baseline was not found, so this run inherits no repository coverage.
scope_inherited_baseline_without_ledger: None: {runId} has no scope ledger, so this run inherits no repository coverage.
scope_inherited_nothing_reusable: None: no unit of {runId} still holds after the current checks.
scope_inherited_carried_with_evidence: Partial: {count} unit(s) of {runId} carried with fingerprints checked against the current source.
scope_reuse_prior_unresolved: {runId} left this unresolved: never carried as covered.
scope_reuse_config_or_dependencies_chang: Workspace configuration or dependency manifests changed.
scope_reuse_dependencies_unknown: Its imports cannot all be established now.
scope_reuse_reused: Reused from {runId}: content, imports, configuration and methods unchanged.
scope_reuse_reused_regex_dependencies: Reused from {runId}: unchanged; its imports were found by a regular-expression scan.
scope_reuse_not_sent: The review did not receive this file.
scope_reuse_unlocated_finding: The review left a finding without a file.
scope_access_reused: {path} is reused from prior evidence (readable as context).
scope_access_excluded: {path} is excluded from the scope: refused.
scope_access_outside_scope: {path} is outside the resolved scope and its allowed context: refused.
scope_access_path_escape: {path} is not a path inside the workspace: refused.
scope_access_not_found: {path} does not exist at the target.
scope_access_expansion_limit: {path} would exceed the context limits: refused.
